title: CutItOut — an open-source AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Need to remove image backgrounds instantly without uploading your photos anywhere? Meet Cut It Out, an open- source AI background remover that runs entirely in your browser. Cut it out uses the powerful UKNET deep learning model running via web assembly and onx so your images never leave your device. And it's not just one-click magic. You get prolevel editing tools, plus zoom and pan for pixel perfect control. Export full resolution transparent PNGs.
